triage.note: ENUMERATED DEBT, NOT A BUG BEING FIXED. American Express FY2008 addresses Part III under ONE combined heading covering four item codes at once -- raw bytes offset 1225493 of evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm: 'ITEMS 10, 11, 12 and 13.' plus the four-item title, then a ~3,000-char body. All four items report `missing` at confidence 0.40 with warning `expected_item_missing` and doc_status `success_with_warning`. An HONEST miss -- low confidence, warning fired, absence admitted -- but a miss: the heading is present and machine-readable, it simply names four codes where every heading path in src/sec10k/segment.py matches exactly one. WHAT THE CHECKS ASSERT: all four items `extracted`, which is what a combined-heading fan-out plus the EXISTING classifier produces, and which satisfies INV-S1. The four caption regions sit at strictly increasing, disjoint offsets in normalized_text -- item 10 [328690,329646) 956 chars, item 11 [329646,330009) 363, item 12 [330009,330085) 76, item 13 [330264,330343) 79 -- `no_overlap_ordered` returns None (pass) on that assignment, and `segment.classify` returns `extracted` on each of the four bodies. Items 12 and 13 land on precisely their own content ('...caption "Ownership of Our Common Shares;"' and '...caption "Certain Relationships and Transactions;"'). VERIFY the status on item 10's body: `python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'.');from src.sec10k import normalize,segment;t=normalize.select_and_normalize(open('evals/fixtures/axp-2008/filing.htm','rb').read().decode('utf-8','replace'))[0];print(segment.classify('10',t[328690:329646],True))"` -> `extracted`. `extracted` and not `incorporated_by_reference` is correct under ADR-004 for item 10 because its body is not pointer-only: after the proxy-IBR lead-in it carries ~1,139 chars of substantive standalone prose (the Corporate Governance Principles / Code of Conduct paragraph, Reg S-K Item 406 code-of-ethics content, which explicitly says the linked website material 'is not incorporated by reference into this report'), and ADR-007's remainder rule takes IBR only when the non-pointer remainder is <= IBR_REMAINDER_MAX (300). WHAT THE INTERLEAVING ACTUALLY COSTS -- and what it does NOT: the block's ten caption bullets address items in the order 10, 10, 11, 10, 11, 12, 10, 11, 13, 10. That forecloses a partition in which item 10 receives the COMPLETE block while items 11-13 also hold their own spans -- item 10 gets 956 of the block's 3,263 chars under the partition above, not all of it. It does NOT put items 11-13 beyond the contract, and it does not implicate INV-S1, which checks exactly `s2 < e1` over spans in item order and nothing more. The `min_chars` floor on item 10 is therefore 500, not 2,000: 500 is cleared by both contract-valid fan-out designs (956 under the partition, 3,263 under whole-block-to-item-10) while still ruling out a degenerate fan-out that attaches only the heading line. A DESIGN CONSTRAINT FOUND WHILE VALIDATING THE PARTITION, recorded so the eventual fix does not trip on it: the adapter's `verbatim` check requires a span to open with its own `heading_text`, so a fan-out must not copy the combined heading string onto all four items -- items 11-13's spans do not open with it. That is a choice about what `heading_text` means for a shared heading, not a reachability problem, which is why `verbatim` is not among this case's hygiene checks while `no_overlap_ordered` and `no_empty_success` are. WHY IT IS NOT FIXED: combined-heading fan-out is a new capability, forbidden by the T8 freeze without its own ADR -- the same reasoning that leaves ba-2003 and cvx-2015 unfixed. Asserting all four statuses is also what stops a PARTIAL fan-out (item 10 only, items 11-13 left missing) from satisfying this case's 'NOW GREEN -- promote it' contract. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND ITSELF: this is the only item-recall gap in either eval set occurring in a real EDGAR filing with content present to find. The other 11 `missing` items across both sets are either genuinely absent from their documents (xom-2021 item 6; malformed-html item 1A) or sit in synthetic fixtures whose own committed expectations assert `missing` is the CORRECT answer (heading-unnumbered item 8; items-stripped-escalation items 5/6/7/7A/8/9/9A/9B). These four are therefore the ENTIRE real-filing fallback-addressable surface ADR-020 weighs: 4 of 768 distinct items. ADR-020 still rules the LLM fallback out, because the same deterministic fan-out reaches all four at $0 and closes the whole class, rather than the instances a model happens to be invoked on. THREE EARLIER DRAFTS OF THIS CASE WERE WRONG, all caught by review and all recorded rather than quietly replaced: round 0 asserted `incorporated_by_reference` x4 (contradicted by `classify`; R1), round 1 asserted `extracted` x4 with a 2,000-char item-10 floor (the floor pins the whole block, which the partition cannot give; R15), round 2 narrowed to item 10 alone on the false premise that no ordered disjoint partition exists (contradicted by running `no_overlap_ordered` on one; R15). WHY THIS CASE IS PERMITTED TO STAY RED, AND WHY ITS CONTRACT IS STILL UNREACHABLE (D9 ruling, 2026-08-26): specs/decisions/ADR-034-pointer-and-fanout-rulings.md rules the combined-heading fan-out SUBSUMED BY D11 rather than promoted to a capability milestone, and narrows ADR-020's stated preference for the deterministic fix in place. Three measurements carry it. (1) PREVALENCE: the class has exactly ONE member in 49 documents -- axp-2008 is the only filing whose multi-code string is a BODY HEADING OVER ITEM CONTENT, at normalized offset 328679 -- and zero held-out items. The scan hits 18 fixtures emitting 39 individual hits; the other 17 fixtures carry the string as 5 cover-page proxy-incorporation sentences, 1 financial-statements index heading, 5 numeric table artifacts, 4 prose cross-references between sibling items, 1 TOC line and 3 synthetic fixtures (20 bucket entries over 18 fixtures, because gs-2002 and xom-2021 each hit in two buckets), and NONE OF THEM LOSES AN ITEM TO THAT STRING. NOTE WHAT THAT DOES AND DOES NOT SAY, corrected under PR #56 R9: a multi-code string co-occurring with missing items is NOT unique to axp-2008 even among real filings -- c-2025 (cover string, items 10-14 missing) and xom-2021 (prose string at offset 39731, item 6 missing, and item 6 is absent from the document entirely so no string could reach it) both show the co-occurrence with no causal link. The class is the body heading, not the co-occurrence. CORRECTED UNDER PR #56 REVIEW, both halves: the denominator read 17/16 and is 18/17 (R4), and this note previously said those filings 'lose no Part III items', which is FALSE for c-2025 -- its items 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 all report missing at 0.40 with null offsets. c-2025 loses them to having no body item headings anywhere (a bare-code cross-reference index), NOT to the multi-code string, and a fan-out over its cover sentence reaches none of them (R1). Recall at stake: 4 items of 891 distinct items. (2) THE FIX IS NOT THE REGEX ADR-020 COSTED, re-verified by running the classifier rather than citing the correction: segment.classify('10', body, True) returns incorporated_by_reference on the heading-STRIPPED item-10 partition body (the slice the pipeline actually passes), not extracted -- so this case's asserted status set is produced by no contract-valid fan-out and its NOW-GREEN-promote-it contract stays unreachable, the defect PR #11 R1 first raised and PR #11 R19 pinned. Item 9B's span is also [326876,331942), containing the whole Part III block, so a fan-out must truncate a neighbouring extracted item or no_overlap_ordered fails on the pair '9B and 10'. (3) axp-2008 IS NO LONGER THE ONLY REAL-FILING RECALL GAP: the held-out c-2025 reports 21 missing items in a real EDGAR filing whose content a reader can point to, and a fan-out reaches none of them -- its only multi-code string is a cover sentence. axp-2008 already escalates on the expected_item_missing warning it emits today, at an ESTIMATED ~$0.18 for one sonnet-5 pass over the whole filing. ADR-034 section f names what reopens it: one further real filing whose BODY heading names several codes and loses items to it, or D11 declining to escalate on expected_item_missing. Choosing which design this case pins and re-deriving its status set remains open debt under the ADR-020 fan-out row; D9 did not do it, because doing it is the capability work D9 declined.

provenance: T12 (2026-08-19/20), ADR-020. Scope corrected three times under review; every correction is recorded here rather than silently applied. Round 1 (PR #11 R1) replaced an `incorporated_by_reference` x4 assertion that src.sec10k.segment.classify contradicts. Round 2 (R8) narrowed the case to item 10, on the claim that INV-S1 admits no four-way partition. Round 3 (R15) showed that claim false by exhibiting one and running the check: the case is back to four `extracted` assertions, with the item-10 floor lowered from 2,000 to 500 because the round-1 floor silently encoded the whole-block design the partition cannot satisfy. FOUND: by reading the committed held-out report evals/report/20260817-224952-fast.json (axp-2008-heldout: items 10, 11, 12, 13 all status=missing, confidence=0.40) against the document itself. The combined heading was verified in the RAW BYTES: re.finditer(r'ITEMS\b', raw) over the fixture returns exactly ONE hit, at offset 1225493. The singular strings 'Item 10'..'Item 13' occur zero times, which is what the original held-out provenance checked; its conclusion -- 'addressed Part III without writing the item headings at all' -- overreached from a singular-form scan. This filer writes Part III item codes WITHOUT the word 'Item' in both places it names them: the combined body heading, and its table of contents, which lists them as bare '10.' / '11.' / '12.' / '13.' entries that generate no heading candidates -- which is why trace layer 'candidates' reports toc_manifest: [] on a filing that has a complete TOC. THE ASSERTED STATUSES ARE NOT JUDGEMENT CALLS. Each was produced by running the code that owns the decision, not by reading a spec in prose -- which is how the three superseded drafts went wrong. `segment.classify` returns `extracted` on all four partition bodies, and `eval_adapter.eval_check(..., 'no_overlap_ordered')` returns None on the four-span assignment. The min_chars floor pins that a real sub-block is attached rather than the heading line alone. Fixture moved to evals/fixtures/axp-2008/ when the held-out case was burned (ADR-020 section g). If these ever go green the runner says 'NOW GREEN -- promote it'.
